newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area early Friday, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 100 slaughter steers; 1,500 head confirmed for the week which includes 1,400 head or 35 loads CME cattle delivered to area packing plants; following weekly movement of 132,600 head. Confirmed - 100
Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 66.00, North Plains.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
